title: Quantifying Health Inequalities Induced by Data and AI Models
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It focuses on quantifying health inequalities based on gender and race (White vs. non-White) induced by data and AI models.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
